hypothesis: The current native Android staging has no source-owned immersive system bar enforcement and native mouse can trigger status/nav overlays at edges; adding a focus/pause-safe immersive mode adapter at API26-29 and API30+ reduces accidental bar exposure without altering UI, display resolution, touch, or OS mandatory navigation.
approach: Use separate BeforeSceneLoad Android-only component; API30+ window.getInsetsController hide WindowInsets.Type.systemBars with transient gestures behavior; API26-29 merge legacy IMMERSIVE_STICKY fullscreen/hide_navigation flags without clobbering existing View flags. Reapply periodically only when focused; no gestures/exclusion overrides. Bound tests and authentic Unity2021 managed compile in independent existing T4 CI.
status_detail: No native build or phone acceptance. Keep T5 Settings ownership and existing mouse capture callbacks untouched.
